description: Compares a base and a head OpenAPI 3.x spec (JSON object, or a JSON or YAML string) from the API consumer's point of view and lists what would break existing clients: removed operations or 2xx responses, new required parameters or request properties, optional-to-required changes, narrowed request enums and tightened constraints, removed or now-optional response properties, widened response enums, type changes, and newly required security. Additive changes are reported as info. Matches operations by method and path template, so renaming a path parameter is not a change. Local $refs are resolved; remote refs are never fetched. Suggests the semver bump and says whether the head version already reflects it. Deterministic, no LLM.

base.description: The current (old) spec: an OpenAPI 3.x document as a JSON object, or as a JSON or YAML string. YAML anchors and aliases are rejected. 4 MB request limit.

paths.description: Path template to Path Item Object.

head.description: The proposed (new) spec, in the same forms as base.
